C6 Interconnect Requirements
C6.1 About the interconnect requirements


C6.1    About the interconnect requirements

                             It is the responsibility of the interconnect to:
                          •      receive transactions from an initiating master
                          •     determine the order of transactions when multiple transactions are received at the same time 仲裁
                          •      issue snoop transactions, as required, for each transaction from an initiating master 发送嗅探请求
                          •      receive snoop responses and data, when data is provided, from a snooped master 接收嗅探信息包括响应和数据
                          •     generate the response for the initiating master 响应master设备发送的请求
                          •      carry out any required access to main memory.                                        需要的时候负责访问main memory
